description: Light-vehicle factor model. Production = glider mass (curb mass minus the traction battery) x kgCO2ePerKg + battery kWh x kgCO2ePerKWh. Driving per km grows with curb mass: fuel kg CO2e/km (well-to-wheel) = fuelKgCO2ePerKm + fuelKgCO2ePerKmPerTonne x tonnes on the fuel share; wall electricity kWh/km = kWhPerKm + kWhPerKmPerTonne x tonnes on electricShare, times the user's grid. Battery kWh = batteryKWh + batteryKWhPerTonne x tonnes. Per-km coefficients are fitted to EPA combined ratings of common models by curb mass.
